Subscribe to my Substack for deeper dives into big theology questions. https://open.substack.com/pub/theolog... What is Theology? Welcome to Theology Made, where we take complicated ideas about God and make them simple. This teaching is an introduction to systematic theology. Theology matters, especially systematic theology, our doctrine shapes so much about how we think of God, ourselves and the world. In this video you will be introduce to the basics of theological education, you will uncover why the word religion is actually a good thing, what are the subdivisions of theology, what is the process for doing good theology, and how does this apply to our everyday life? If you find this teaching helpful, hit subscribe and join the Theology Made community! ______________ Introduction to Systematic Theology books I recommend Introduction to Systematic Theology, Wayne Grudem: https://amzn.to/3UT2Z0d Concise Systematic Theology, John Frame: https://amzn.to/3UREpg8 Christian Theology, Millard Erickson: https://amzn.to/42VSdbx The Christian Faith, Michael Horton: https://amzn.to/49rHKHc (this is one is particularly fascinating) ______________ #Theology #whatistheology #systematictheology #whatissystematictheology #religion #overviewofsystematictheology #christiantheology #theologicaleducation …...more ...more Show less Transcript Follow along using the transcript.
